notes: Clicked for credits nearly every turn up to 54 credits without installing breakers or contesting remotes; let the Corp advance and score three agendas uncontested, and even declined to pay 2 to get through Loot Box.
Scored steadily from iced remotes and used an Urtica Cipher trap well; some idle credit clicks with a full hand and a thin economy, against a passive Runner.
Started with aggressive R&D/HQ pressure (including redundant HQ runs), then from turn 8 only clicked for credits up to 41 while the Corp advanced and scored three agendas uncontested.
Built a strong asset and fast-advance engine and won through Seamless Launch and Otto clicks; the Drafter install of Architect Deployment Test into a server with no ice got stolen.
Found the soft HQ and hit it repeatedly to win quickly; a few aimless early clicks and an odd Underdome install, but the plan was sound.
Installed and advanced agendas in naked remotes twice (ADT, then Méliès for the loss), spent down to 0 credits early, and iced an empty remote.
Built a good economy, then paid through Grubber/Paywall to take HQ agendas, and contested the remote at the right times to win on turn 8.
Got 3 points from a turn-1 HQ blitz, then clicked for credits up to 73 with no breakers or runs while the Corp scored four agendas from lightly iced remotes.
Mitosis into two naked remotes lost Lotus Haze, Neurospike was fired for nothing, credits sat near 0 all game, and HQ/R&D ice was never rezzed, so a Longevity Serum was taken from HQ for the loss.
Mitosis put two Longevity Serums in naked remotes and both were stolen immediately; otherwise it scored sensibly from an iced remote against a passive Runner.
Kept installing Tomorrow's Headline into a remote the Runner could clearly pass and lost it three times, spent many turns clicking for credits with a full hand, and eventually decked.
Ran low on credits all game, facechecked remotes while nearly broke, and ran R&D through Banner while the Corp advanced and scored remote agendas behind a single Afshar.
Held several agendas in an HQ behind one Virtual Service Agent and kept drawing and tagging instead of protecting HQ or installing them, and lost on turn 4.
Used Red Team well, contested the advanced remote and won on turn 8; the only cost was a reasonable hit from an Urtica trap.
Spent many turns on economy (three Daily Casts) while the Corp scored from its remote, repeated HQ runs that saw the same cards, and was too poor to contest the final scoring remote.
Left R&D behind one cheap Ablative Barrier during an obvious R&D lock while stacking three ice on an empty remote and clicking for credits at 13+, and never installed an agenda.
Used Banner and Buzzsaw well to steal remote agendas early, survived Measured Response, and finished with R&D pressure; a few redundant HQ runs.
Discarded Flower Sermon into an open Archives, then installed Yagi-Uda and Fujii behind a single Karunā with no money to defend; credits stayed near zero.
Fast-advanced agendas well with Seamless Launch and Otto, but sat at 0 credits for many turns with R&D and HQ ice unrezzed, giving the Runner free multi-access.
Contested the remote well and stole five agendas, but spent turns 12 and 14-17 only clicking for credits with a full grip and 13-23 credits instead of pressuring centrals.
